label: New York regulates lasers
detail: Industrial Code Rule 50 takes effect, ahead of the US federal laser standard.

label: FDA Laser Notice 22
detail: Light shows fall under the federal standard and show producers count as manufacturers. FDA pages date it November 22 or 23.

label: 21 CFR 1040.11(c) takes its current form
detail: The demonstration laser rule names Classes I, IIa, II and IIIa (50 FR 33702).

label: HSE publishes HS(G)95
detail: UK guidance on display laser safety, published in October to replace note PM19 of 1980; since withdrawn.

label: O'Hagan thesis
detail: A Loughborough University PhD on entertainment laser risk finds audience scanning not acceptable as then practiced.

label: FDA Laser Notice 51
detail: Projectors may be delivered only to customers holding an approved variance.

label: FDA Laser Notice 55
detail: Streamlined yearly renewal for eligible show variances; audience scanning excluded.

label: Aquamarine festival eye injuries
detail: Festivalgoers in Kirzhach, Russia, are treated for retinal injuries after a July laser show; reports give 12, 29 or more than 30 patients.

label: 18 U.S.C. 39A
detail: Aiming a laser pointer at an aircraft becomes a US federal crime under Public Law 112-95.

label: Seoul club case report
detail: Clinical Ophthalmology publishes two retinal injuries after a club laser show; both patients recovered after surgery.

label: PLASA display laser guidance
detail: PLASA publishes the guide HSE now points to in place of HS(G)95.

label: Canada restricts hand-held lasers
detail: SOR/2020-124 is registered, banning hand-held lasers over 1 mW near airports and in three metro regions.

label: DGUV Information 203-036
detail: Germany's accident insurers issue the January 2021 edition of their show laser guidance.

label: FAA Advisory Circular 70-1B
detail: Current FAA guidance on outdoor laser operations; Change 1 followed on May 5, 2022.

label: FAA reports 2025 laser strikes
detail: 10,994 strikes on aircraft in 2025, down 14% from 2024; the record is 13,304 in 2023.
